description: Update dashboard.py to display all new bot tables: discovery_cycles, candidate_observations, cohort_candidates, candidate_alert_claims, outcome_jobs, market_observations, candidate_outcomes, and calibration_runs. Add new API endpoints and UI sections for pipeline visibility, calibration review, and outcome tracking.
steps: Add CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements for all new tables in the dashboard's get_db() function
Add api_discovery() endpoint showing recent discovery cycles and candidate counts
Add api_candidates() endpoint showing candidate observations with filtering by decision
Add api_cohort() endpoint showing cohort candidates with their initial scores and decisions
Add api_outcomes() endpoint showing outcome jobs status and completed candidate_outcomes
Add api_calibration() endpoint showing calibration runs and their report summaries
Add HTML/CSS/JS sections for Discovery Pipeline, Candidates, Outcomes, and Calibration Review panels
Wire new API endpoints into DashboardHandler.do_GET()
Add tab navigation to switch between Paper Trading view and Pipeline/Calibration views
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays discovery cycle history (timestamp, source status, candidate count)
Dashboard displays candidate observations with decision breakdown (ALERT, REJECT, DEFERRED)
Dashboard displays cohort candidates with initial scores
Dashboard displays outcome job status summary (PENDING, CAPTURED, MISSED_WINDOW counts)
Dashboard displays candidate outcomes (price return %, 2x events)
Dashboard displays calibration run history with status and report summaries
New API endpoints return correct JSON data from the new tables
Dashboard still works when new tables are empty (graceful empty states)
verification: python -c "from memescanner.dashboard import api_discovery, api_candidates, api_cohort, api_outcomes, api_calibration; print('OK')"
findings: All 519 tests pass. Dashboard now reads from all 8 new bot tables. Added 6 new API endpoints (discovery, candidates, cohort, outcomes, calibration, pipeline) and tab-based UI navigation. The scan_count in api_stats() now uses the actual discovery_cycles table count instead of the previous rough approximation. All endpoints gracefully handle empty tables. Integration tested with populated data verifying correct JSON output for all endpoints.
